# Dense notation regression

`dense-marimba.png` is a 691×220 crop at (0,40) from the 691×949 perspective-prepared analysis image of the user-supplied “WhatsApp Image 2026-11-08 at 21.04.51.jpeg” (2026-11-08). It retains the four printed staves of the first system. No staff lines or symbols were reconstructed for the fixture.

The lower Marimba staff was detected as two fragments before the change. The regression checks four observations, support on both sides of the beamed region, and preservation of the five-line spacing phase. This is a detection regression, not a musical transcription ground truth.


`tied-chords.png` is the unmodified 1800×430 crop at (0,700) of the iPhone's 1800×2527 page-analysis raster from the user-supplied “Blubb” photo (2026-11-10). The raster was replayed using the saved page grid and original decoded pixels. The upper staff's parallel ties previously attracted the fine tracker to a compressed, displaced five-line packet; its left half was then lost. Independent visible middle-rule anchors in this crop are approximately (500,133), (780,137), (950,140), (1100,141), (1500,142), with roughly 16–17 px spacing. The regression checks those anchors, spacing and both measured ends; it does not assert musical transcription.
